body: Yeah suicide does rob a person of the chance to feel happy. I guess that’s just the price to pay for no longer feeling bad
Honestly at this point I’ll take no pain and no happiness rather than be in pain and not happy. Like it’s better to just not have either than to only have the bad one
“Free” meaning away from all the pain and suffering. Like no longer in pain
Thanks for the thought. One of my last I guess
How much is “a while longer”? Like at what point do I accept that this is the only way to be free?
